captain-rex--into-the-firefight.text: When Played/When this unit completes an attack: Give this unit and an enemy unit Sentinel for this phase.
captain-rex--into-the-firefight.rules: A unit must survive an attack to trigger its “when this unit completes an attack” abilities.

the-invisible-hand--crawling-with-vultur.text: When Played/When this unit completes an attack : You may search the top 8 cards of your deck for a Droid unit, reveal it, and draw it. If it costs 2 or less, you may play it for free.

jabba-the-hutt--eminence-of-tatooine.text:
Restore 2
When Played: You may return an upgrade to its owner's hand. If it's returned to your hand, you may play it for free.
jabba-the-hutt--eminence-of-tatooine.rules:
Abilities that return a card to hand must choose a card in play unless otherwise specified.
“Play for free” ignores all resource costs, including the aspect penalty, but not other additional costs.

retaliation.text: Defeat a unit that dealt damage to a base this phase.
